detail.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: Attention is focused on assumption_challenge as part of the rotation policy, and no active project currently covers this domain.

children.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models

detail.title: Systematic Assumption Testing in Self-Correcting Models
detail.summary: By integrating the governance module's immutability as a fixed constraint, WAKE identifies its own boundary conditions as testable assumptions. Governance stability is maintained through the verifiable rejection of model-authored proposal transitions.
detail.reason: Revision of the assumption challenge notebook to incorporate updated source evidence and sharpen the findings on governance-constrained stability.

detail.reason: Clarifying the boundary between modifiable heuristics and rigid foundational assumptions is required to advance the assumption testing project.
